decisive_items: the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions
Orbital computed tomography demonstrated a purely conjunctival, homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures.
response.rationale: The description of a pinkish-yellow conjunctival mass and the imaging findings are more consistent with conjunctival amyloidosis than the other options.

rejected.why: The atypical color of the mass does not strongly support a lymphoproliferative disorder.
The description of a soft-tissue lesion is not specific enough to support conjunctival fibroma.
While the description of a soft-tissue lesion supports conjunctival granuloma, the imaging findings and mass appearance are more consistent with conjunctival amyloidosis.
